text:
Nina (CS): FYI Acme just jumped their monthly run rate. Our QBR forecast shifted +31% since yesterday. Need quick mitigation + a tidy slide for Friday.
Omar (FinOps): On it. Can someone tell me which product call is dominant? embeddings vs chat vs fine-tuning?
Kira (Onboarding): Embeddings heavy. They ingested a large transcript set and kicked off continuous re-embeds for dedupe.
Jules (Solutions Eng): They also enabled the high-dim embedding flag in config (`dim=2048`) instead of our recommended `dim=512`. That explains the token and compute delta.
BudgetBot: :warning: Project ACME-42 usage at 82% of monthly credits.
Omar (FinOps): Thanks bot. Quick math: unchecked additional monthly spend ~ $9.3k.
Nina (CS): We need a customer-facing plan: immediate throttle, lower-dim model + quantized variant, and an ask (credits buffer or week-long Dedicated trial). Thoughts?
Jules (Solutions Eng): Technical plan (fastest-first): 1) switch embeddings to `embed-512-quant` (stateless config flip), 2) turn on chunk-level caching for repeated docs, 3) enable batching with continuous batching window 50ms. That should cut compute ~58-70% depending on duplication.
Kira (Onboarding): I can push the model flip and flip back if needed. Also can pause the re-embed job while we sync with the customer.
InfraBot: :information_source: Action created: ACME-cost-mitigation, owner=@Jules, priority=high.
Omar (FinOps): Recommend offering a 2-week Dedicated pool trial (small) OR a conditional 15% one-time credits buffer to smooth renewal sentiment. Which has lower ops risk?
Jules (Solutions Eng): Dedicated trial is better for throughput predictability and shows value. Ops overhead moderate but doable. Credits buffer is faster but gives no perf guarantee.
Nina (CS): Let's propose both as options in the QBR slide: primary: 2-week Dedicated trial + enable optimize recommendations; fallback: 15% credits buffer + technical enablement session.
BudgetBot: :white_check_mark: Log: ACME-cost-mitigation updated with proposal options.
Omar (FinOps): For the QBR slide I'll include: current vs projected spend, reduction estimates per mitigation, ask options, and CTA. Estimated reduction numbers: quantized embed -> ~58% compute drop; batching+cache -> additional ~20%. Combined ~70%.
Kira (Onboarding): Paused continuous re-embeds at 09:12PT. Requeues are staged at low concurrency.
Nina (CS): Can we also show a quick runbook for their engineers? A tiny snippet they can apply right away.
Jules (Solutions Eng): Adding runbook snippet (paste to Ops channel):
```bash
# set soft quota via API (example)
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/ACME-42/quota" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"soft_limit_pct":60, "hard_limit_pct":90}'

# quick embed model flip
PATCH /v1/projects/ACME-42/config
{ "embedding_model": "embed-512-quant" }
```
Omar (FinOps): I'll finalize the slide and numbers. Nina, propose the customer message and I'll co-sign. ETA 2 hours.
Nina (CS): Will draft customer note: short, apologetic, mitigation steps, ask to join 30m ops call. Will share in 30m for review.
Jules (Solutions Eng): Also adding a short appendix: pre-QBR metrics to show (per-route token rates, percent repeated docs, avg seq len).
BudgetBot: :zap: Reminder scheduled: QBR deck due for review 24h before meeting.
Nina (CS): Action list: Omar finalize slide (ETA 2h), Jules finalize runbook + appendix, Kira keep imports paused and maintain reduced concurrency, Nina draft customer note and book ops call.
Kira (Onboarding): Confirmed paused. I'll only re-enable at explicit sign-off.
Nina (CS): Good. We'll propose Dedicated trial + enable Redwood Optimize suggestions in QBR. If they take credits buffer, we track it as a one-off concession and tie to technical adoption milestones.
Omar (FinOps): Added renewal-risk flag to the account: severity=medium-high. I'll surface to AMs.
Nina (CS): Closing here for now. Please post any slide updates to this thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
